Title: Upgrade your Azure Cache for Redis instances to use Redis version 6 by 30 June 2023

Body.Content:
Because Redis version 4 is no longer supported by the open source community, it will be retired from Azure Cache for Redis and you'll need to upgrade any cache instances that are running version 4 to version 6 by 30 June 2023. We'll continue to backport security fixes from recent versions to version 4 until that date.

Required action

To avoid an automatic update to your cache instances, upgrade your Azure Cache for Redis instances to Redis version 6 by 30 June 2023.

Help and support

If you have questions, get answers from community experts in Microsoft Q&A. If you have a support plan and you need technical help, create a support request:

  1. For Issue type, select Technical.
  2. For Subscription, select your subscription.
  3. For Service, select My services.
  4. For Service type, select Cache for Redis.
  5. For Resource, select your resource.
  6. For Summary, type a description of your issue.
  7. For Problem type, select Cache Management.
  8. For Problem subtype, select Upgrade.
